text:
Jules Ramos: Heads-up — HeliosTech (acct: helios-632) just pinged. Sales confirmed a $50,000 contract promo tied to PO PO-8891 that should have been applied as an invoice credit, but their invoice shows the full amount due. Customer is asking for a manual adjustment and an explanation. Also reports intermittent 503s when calling /v1/embeddings during their heavy syncs.

Tom Brenner: Thanks Jules. Confirming PO-8891, sales note: "Contract promo: apply enterprise credit $50k on first invoice; reference PO-8891; auto-apply if PO note present." I added the PO note on 2026-02-18, Sam handled the deal.

Sam Ortega: Yep that was me. I included the PO note in Salesforce and in our internal deal ticket (#D-4429). Thought billing automation would pick it up. @Priya can you check why it didn't? :eyes:

billing-bot: ledger-check --tenant helios-632 --po PO-8891
Output: {
  "invoices_found": 1,
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-0047",
  "credits_attached": 0,
  "promo_tag": "PO-8891"
}

Priya Patel: Looking at the automation logs, the PO parsing pipeline rejected the note because it didn't include the exact token "APPLY_CREDIT" we look for. Sales used free-form text. The rule is currently strict to avoid accidental grants.

Nora Li: That explains it. We should not change parsing heuristics ad-hoc. For urgent fix: I can apply a manual ledger adjustment and regenerate invoice. Priya, can you authorize the manual apply? We need a journal entry and a note linking back to sales ticket.

Tom Brenner: Authorize from sales side — marking this as approved. Sam, can you paste the sales approval line so Finance has audit trail?

Sam Ortega: Copying approval: "Approved: Sam Ortega (AE) — apply contract promo $50,000 to INV-2026-0047 per PO-8891. Signed 2026-02-18."

Priya Patel: Authorized. Creating manual adjustment now. Using internal tool: 
```
apply-ledger-credit --tenant helios-632 --invoice INV-2026-0047 --amount 50000 --reason "Contract promo PO-8891 (sales approval D-4429)" --requested-by "Sam Ortega"
```
Command submitted: job 442901. Expected completion ~2m.

billing-bot: job 442901 status: completed. Journal entry JD-11077 created. Invoice INV-2026-0047 updated: balance reduced by $50,000. PDF regenerated.

Jules Ramos: Sent regenerated invoice and explanatory note to customer, asked them to confirm receipt. Also offered a one-week usage buffer while they validate production traffic. :thumbsup:

Sam Ortega: Thanks team. I'll update the Salesforce deal and attach JD-11077 and the regenerated invoice.

Nora Li: Quick note on the 503s — separate thread but initial logs show their agents bulk-requesting embeddings with very long sequences, causing occasional OOM/timeout in the GPU pool. Notified eng-runtime. Will follow up in eng-runtime channel with a stack trace.

Priya Patel: Closing the billing side: manual credit applied and audit logged. Please keep PO format guidance for future deals: include the token "APPLY_CREDIT" and the exact credit amount in the PO note. I'll draft a short checklist for Sales.

Jules Ramos: Customer confirmed invoice received and shows $0 balance. They appreciated the quick turnaround. Closing case — will post summary to the CS ticket (CS-7812). :white_check_mark:

Tom Brenner: Adding checklist to the deal playbook now. Thanks everyone.

Sam Ortega: FYI — will add a follow-up with the customer about the embeddings errors once eng-runtime posts root cause.

Nora Li: Filed eng-runtime ticket ER-913. Will link back here.

Jules Ramos: Great. Closing thread.
